rationale: Formatting, indentation, import order and NOPMD comment removal only; no behaviour change.
Validation on path and build changes from size 2..20 to 2..120; longer values previously rejected are now accepted. Contract has no constraint.
Adds test-only router constructors and renames a parameter; no HTTP behaviour change.

Azure AD SSO library switched from adal4j to msal4j; role lookup now uses homeAccountId instead of uniqueId, and refresh logic differs (refresh failures now return true). Resulting permissions and session behaviour may differ.
Internal DB transaction helper refactor; WithTx now reuses an existing transaction instead of erroring. Callers shown were already AutoTx; no clear HTTP-visible change.
Question page canonical URL now uses the short /questions/{id} form also for the new PermalinkQuestionIDByShortID setting; previously it kept the title-suffixed form.
Adds severity-count fields to an ORM model struct only; no visible request outcome changes in the provided code.
Lambda parameter cleanup, parameter rename and fun interface conversion; no behaviour change.

Stop scan-all endpoint now also sets a cache stop mark so the scan-all loop ends and no further artifacts are scanned; previously only the execution was stopped. Handler can now return an error from the stop call.
Only required web contexts now fail startup on unavailability; before, any failing web app caused server exit. Otherwise-failing optional apps no longer prevent the API from being served.
Adds a deprecation log call on flow initialisation only.

PUT process update now prefills config from the existing process, so omitted fields keep current values instead of defaults; unknown id now returns 404 before JSON validation. Contract describes the operation as replace.
Callers adapted to a changed file manager interface (renamed methods, swapped args, temp upload flow); implementation not provided so effect on requests cannot be judged.
